about: Roadster v3 「比墙还陡」 exact narration (director: Opus 5.5). Text strings are LOCKED for synthesis once Codex returns GO. Start times are nominal edit intentions; after synthesis, measured clip durations and word boundaries drive the final cut (same rule as v2: no time-stretch, voice placement moves, picture holds absorb slack). Every reveal is keyed to a word in 'anchors'.
film: Roadster v3 「比墙还陡」 combined ramp + kickflip
status: director draft awaiting Codex fact/feasibility GO

voice.post: Trim exterior silence only. No time-stretch, no pitch shift. One clip per line id.
voice.reason_unchanged: Continuity with v2; no concrete evidence yet that another voice is better. Revisit only if measured clips show misreads or the delivery is flat on L04/L08.

tone_meaning.air: borrowed: the surrounding atmosphere and what it does
tone_meaning.gas: carried: the stored high-pressure gas and its jets

caption_rules: One phrase on screen at a time, no box, soft shadow, centre x=540, baseline y≈1330, 600 weight 60 px. display=title/kinetic/endcard lines replace the bottom caption for that line.

lines.text: 比墙还陡，它怎么掉不下来？

anchors.event: title_big already on frame 0 (900 weight); voice confirms it
title_small in

lines.placement: Start 0.20-0.30 s. Must end at least 0.15 s before the cut to S2.

lines.text: 风扇抽走车底缝隙里的空气，

phrases.text: 风扇抽走车底缝隙里的空气

anchors.event: schematic fan intake rings under the floor + label 风扇抽气 · 示意
air streaks inside the gap stream into the intakes and fade; gap density drops
cut to P2 lands; thin outline of the low-pressure lens between floor and slope
label 低压 inside the lens

lines.placement: After the gravity arrow has been on screen for at least 0.4 s.

lines.text: 外面的空气，就把它压在坡上。

anchors.event: impact ticks bloom on every outer surface, normal to the skin, long outside and short in the gap
ticks slide together and merge into ONE red press arrow along the local slope normal (lands on this syllable)
arrow tip touches the slope; slope-normal hairline flashes

lines.placement: Cut back to P1 0.2 s before the line.

phrases.display: kinetic_glyph 压 replaces struck 吸

anchors.event: giant 吸 (900, ~260 px) appears in the void left of the car
吸 is struck through and knocked out; 压 slams in force red; press arrow pulses once; sub thump

lines.placement: No bottom caption for this line.

lines.section: S4 press (P3 tyre close-up, time creeps)

anchors.event: contact patch flares warm-white
short traction arrows along the slope toward the lip at each visible contact patch; car creeps forward

lines.placement: Cut to P3 0.15 s before the line.

lines.text: 这股力始终压向坡面，哪怕是往上。

anchors.event: press arrows grow on the strobe ghosts, base to top, 0.22 s stagger, each along its local slope normal
thin white gravity arrows fade in on every ghost, all parallel and straight down
overhang ghost's arrow flares; dotted vertical component tick shows it points partly UP

lines.placement: Begins as the last strobe ghost lands.

anchors.event: hairline white rule marks the lip edge

lines.placement: Car still fully on the slope; press arrow still alive.

lines.text: 车底下没了坡，就压不住了。

anchors.event: floor begins to overhang the edge (fitted ev ~9.25); the low-pressure lens shrinks from the front as the gap opens; the press arrow shortens in proportion (schematic, progressive, no sudden pop)
first observed jet near the nose (source ev 9.5) fires during the weakening: the relay begins (jet hiss ducked under voice)
the last of the floor leaves the edge (fitted ev ~9.7): only now does the arrow's remainder break into warm specks and scatter

lines.placement: Slow-motion mapping is chosen so 压不住 lands when the fitted vehicle floor has fully left the slope. Do not imply the source measured a specific failure moment.

lines.section: S7 x-ray (frozen just past the lip)
lines.text: 腾空以后，换自带的高压气接力。

anchors.event: scan line sweeps nose to tail; body turns to dark glass
vessel label 碳纤维缠绕压力容器 / 据特斯拉 · 位置示意
one flow pulse runs from the vessels to the nozzle that is already firing

lines.placement: Freeze holds until the line ends; cut to S8 on the line end.

lines.section: S8 jets (replay-B angle, slow motion then real speed)
lines.text: 气往下喷，车就被往上推。

anchors.event: ice-blue streaks run down the downward plumes (source ev ~10.9-11.2)
red reaction arrows from each nozzle, exactly opposite its drawn plume

lines.placement: 往下喷 must coincide with the observed downward plumes.

anchors.event: slate already reads 另一场演示 · 重建自马斯克 2026.10.16 发布的视频 · CG

lines.placement: At least 0.15 s after the black separation cut. Never over ramp footage.

lines.section: S9 kickflip K2 (v2 torque plates, v3 overlays)

anchors.event: red reaction lines from the active nozzles
dashed lines of action extend and visibly miss the CoM
white CoM ring + label 重心
red arc (from K2) hands over to the real-speed roll

lines.placement: Over real-speed resume; car completes the roll and drops into its cloud.

lines.text: 贴着坡，借的是空气的力；

anchors.event: warm press arrows on the ramp ghosts pulse base to lip

lines.placement: Types on as end-card line 1 (no bottom caption).

lines.text: 腾了空，花的是自己的气。

anchors.event: live car leaves the lip on the poster; strobe drops cold ghosts with jets
ice-blue jets + red reaction arrows on the air ghosts

lines.placement: Types on as end-card line 2 (no bottom caption).

lines.text: 自己的气，总有喷完的时候。

anchors.event: cold jets fade out one by one from the lip down to the cloud; warm ramp arrows stay lit

lines.placement: Final line. Hold at least 1.0 s of picture after it ends, then fade.

pronunciation_checks.why: 缝 alone can be read féng; 缝隙 chosen to force fèng
没 must be méi, not mò

deliberately_not_said: any number: pressure, force, gas mass, vessel size or count, nozzle count, height, speed, time aloft
hover, sustained flight, untethered flight, practicality
that the two demos are one take
how many fans or where they exhaust
